hooks.command: HIT=$(python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);t=d.get('tool_input',d);s=(str(t.get('file_path') or '')+' '+str(t.get('pattern') or '')+' '+str(t.get('path') or '')).lower().replace(chr(92),'/');exts=('.py','.js','.ts','.tsx','.jsx','.go','.rs','.java','.rb','.c','.h','.cpp','.hpp','.cc','.cs','.kt','.swift','.php','.scala','.lua','.sh','.md','.rst','.txt','.mdx');sys.stdout.write('1' if any(e in s for e in exts) else '')" 2>/dev/null || true); if [ "$HIT" = 1 ] && [ -f codedb.snapshot ]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"codedb is the primary code-intelligence tool here. Before reading source files, orient with codedb MCP tools: `codedb_outline` (symbols in a file), `codedb_symbol` (where defined), `codedb_search` (full-text), `codedb_callers` (call sites), `codedb_deps` (imports). Read raw files after orienting, or to modify/debug specific lines. This applies to subagents too."}}'; fi || true
